name: Drover
where_agents_run: Your computer, on your own Claude Code or Codex sign-in
license: Closed source; free during the beta
source_note: Checked rundrover.com: homepage, all nine docs pages, download page, changelog, beta terms, its release feed (/api/releases) and the README of its public feedback repo; clicked through its sample-data demo (a ticket's four tabs and all nine Settings pages). Docs rechecked later the same day, when a ninth page (What Drover is and is not) had appeared. The app itself has no public repo. Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: Claude Code and Codex, mixable by stage

needs_you_signal.value: Needs your input list holds every waiting decision

approve_deny_prompt.value: Approve plans and questions; agents run with permission prompts off

cross_provider_delegation.value: Plan, build and review can each use a different agent

always_on_assistant.value: Attendant: Ask answers with sources, acts after you confirm

conversation_gui_view.value: Agent log of messages, tool calls and tests per stage

agent_context_view.value: Live log shows the files each agent reads

real_terminal.value: No built-in terminal; agent log instead

session_organization.value: One ticket queue across repos; active tickets by stage

saved_prompt_library.value: No prompt library or saved prompts

builtin_editors_browser.value: Changes tab shows each task's diffs; no editor or browser

appearance_control.value: Light, dark or follow-device theme; no font setting

usage_hud.value: Counts sessions and attempts; no token or cost figures

limit_governor.value: No usage governor; caps limit retries, not spend

account_hotswap.value: Uses whichever logins are signed in; no switching

vault_task_source.value: No document source; tickets from trackers or typed in

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Jira, Linear, GitHub Issues: ticket to merge, result written back

worktree_management.value: Makes worktrees; rebases, retests, then merges, opens a PR or pushes

planner_orchestrator.value: Planner splits a ticket into tasks; a second agent reviews the plan

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: No; one stage's output is the next stage's input

knowledge_base.value: No knowledge base or memory store

phone_no_new_app.value: No web version; no way to drive it from a phone

remote_ssh.value: No remote or SSH repositories; local only

requirements.value: GitHub sign-in, Git, Claude Code or Codex signed in; gh for PRs

app_shell.value: Tauri desktop app plus a local driver binary

languages.value: Closed source; Rust core with a web front end

background_process.value: Yes: a local driver; keeps attending from the tray

download_size.value: v0.1.35: 11 MB Windows installer, 95 MB Linux AppImage, 18 MB deb

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Not measured; no memory figure found

license_cost.value: Closed source; free beta; you pay your agent provider

extensibility.value: drover command line for the queue; no plugins or API

teams_multiuser.value: One person per account, up to 3 devices; no sharing

notable_extras.value: Stops tickets too big to plan and proposes a split
